# `aitbc gpu-onchain allocations`

Query on-chain allocations for a GPU.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain allocations [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain allocations --gpu-id <gpu_id>
```
